queries:
WITH tavg AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS overall_avg FROM tavg
),
kept AS (
  SELECT telescref, avg_mod
  FROM tavg, overall
  WHERE avg_mod > overall_avg
)
SELECT telescref, avg_mod / (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM kept) AS ratio
FROM kept
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM (SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY telescref HAVING COUNT(modindex) > 0)
SELECT AVG(COALESCE(avg_mod, 0)) AS overall_avg_modindex
FROM (
  SELECT t.telescregistry, AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_mod
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN signals s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry
);
SELECT telescregistry FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct >= (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes);
SELECT t.telescregistry, AVG(s.sigstrdb) AS avg_sigstrdb
FROM telescopes t
LEFT JOIN signals s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
GROUP BY t.telescregistry
HAVING AVG(s.sigstrdb) IS NOT NULL;
SELECT AVG(modindex) FROM signals;
